dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave spline transition from the apex to the posterior dorsal insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape classification with a minimal pixel radius at the peak.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: High-gradient steepness of approximately 65 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.1:1 ratio of longitudinal base width to maximum vertical pixel height.

anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Stunted snout length with high thickness; minimal extension from the melon.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle where the melon slope meets the anterior snout boundary.
